methods.population: INEGI Censo 2020 ITER POBTOT at 15 March 2020. Own nine-digit localidad only; aggregate LOC 0000/9998/9999 never admitted. Differing undated values corrected together with year. Missing/asterisk counts held, never zero-filled.
methods.identity: Use each later reviewed merged locality-code link, require its complete after-row hash still equal current master and partition. Read original accepted pilot evidence and original v5 holds. Parent code/state/scope and latest identity disposition rechecked. No new identity decisions or events.
methods.continuity: Live latest advertised September 2026 locality and June 2026 municipio editions. Exact active full geocode, census locality and municipio names, POBTOT and both sex counts agree. Bounded official LOCtrRA history queries cover 15 March 2020 through catalogue cut, with complete unsaturated results. Complete bidirectional LOCtrTE queries also test each code as origin and destination, catching incoming mergers invisible to own-code history. Any event except unchanged-code J (urban/rural status only) held. Code continuity is census-to-current catalogue continuity, not surveyed polygon-boundary equality.
methods.hold: All 1000 starting yearless rows accounted once; 813 outside reviewed candidate cohort retain prior explicit holds; candidate reproof failures have individual checks. No municipal total assigned to a seat.
